__comment: Known, tracked defects: test-id (name/connector, name/*, */connector) -> {reason, ref}. A listed failure reports XFAIL; a listed test that passes reports XPASS so the entry gets removed.

anonymous_search/jamendo.reason: the built-in demo client_id is over Jamendo's usage limit: the API answers status=success, results_count=0, warnings='Usage limits are exceeded'; jamendo.go ignores headers.warnings so the provider silently returns no tracks. Needs a user client id in /media/cryptofs/spotify-webos/jamendo-clientid (and jamendo.go should surface the warning as an error).

live_playback/youtube.reason: googlevideo answers 403 to a full GET and to ranges > ~1 MiB (206 for 1 MiB, 403 for 10 MiB, any User-Agent); streamplayer.go pipes a plain `curl -sL <url>` into gst, so the stream is empty and ends at once. The resolver's 'verified' probe uses Range bytes=0-1 and passes. Needs chunked Range fetching, e.g. a /ytstream proxy like /dzstream.
